metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform" {
    model {
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "A customer of the insurance company who reports claims and tracks their progress."

        claimsBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization, consulted to screen claims for fraud." "External"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization, through which claim settlements are executed." "External"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform, where policyholders report claims and claims are processed through triage, assessment, and payout." {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "The web portal where policyholders report claims and track their progress." "Web application" "Web"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "The backend that serves the insurer's mobile app." "REST API"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims." "Microservice"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims." "Microservice"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts." "Microservice"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements." "Microservice"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims." "Microservice"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports." "Microservice"
            notification = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders." "Microservice"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters." "Microservice"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims." "Web application" "Web"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy." "Microservice"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners." "Microservice"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation." "Batch job"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts." "Message queue" "Queue"
            claimsDb = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records." "Relational database" "Database"
            policyDb = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records." "Relational database" "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Relational database" "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence." "Object storage" "Database"
        }

        policyholder -> webPortal "Reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS/JSON"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "Reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS/JSON"

        webPortal -> claimsIntake "Submits new claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> assessment "Requests settlement assessments from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> payout "Requests claim settlements from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> documentService "Uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> notification "Requests status notifications from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntake "Submits new claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "Requests settlement assessments from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "Requests claim settlements from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "Uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> notification "Requests status notifications from" "HTTPS/JSON"

        claimsIntake -> triage "Hands accepted claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        triage -> assessment "Routes claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        assessment -> payout "Requests settlements from" "HTTPS/JSON"

        fraudScreening -> claimsBureau "Consults for fraud screening" "HTTPS/JSON"
        policyVerification -> policyDb "Checks the cover against" "SQL"
        assignment -> adjusterWorkbench "Routes the claim to" "HTTPS/JSON"

        documentService -> documentStore "Reads from" "S3/REST"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDb "Reads and writes claim records" "SQL"
        batchScheduler -> policyDb "Reads and writes policy records" "SQL"
        notification -> policyholder "Reports claim status changes" "Email/SMS"
        payout -> clearingHouse "Executes settlements through" "HTTPS/JSON"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "The policyholder, the Claims Center, and the external systems it interacts with." {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "System Context for Claims Center"
        }

        container claimsCenter "ClaimSubmission" "How a policyholder reports and tracks a claim through intake, assessment, and payout." {
            include policyholder
            include webPortal
            include mobileAppBackend
            include claimsIntake
            include triage
            include assessment
            include payout
            include documentService
            include notification
            include documentStore
            include clearingHouse
            autoLayout
            title "Claim Submission and Settlement"
        }

        container claimsCenter "RiskAndData" "How claims are screened, verified, and assigned, and the data and batch processing behind them." {
            include fraudScreening
            include policyVerification
            include assignment
            include adjusterWorkbench
            include reinsuranceAllocation
            include batchScheduler
            include eventQueue
            include claimsDb
            include policyDb
            include auditDb
            include claimsBureau
            autoLayout
            title "Risk, Assignment and Data"
        }

        styles {
            element "Person" {
                shape Person
                background #08427B
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Software System" {
                background #1168BD
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "External" {
                background #999999
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Container" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Database" {
                shape Cylinder
            }
            element "Web" {
                shape WebBrowser
            }
            element "Queue" {
                shape Pipe
            }
            relationship "Relationship" {
                routing Orthogonal
            }
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope softwaresystem
    }
}

metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Bank Portal" "A C4 model of the online banking platform" {

    model {

        bankCustomer = person "Bank Customer" "A customer of the bank who uses the platform to manage their accounts, move money, and track their activity."

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform, owned and operated by our company." {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts."
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app."
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records."
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers."
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers."
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards."
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud."
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts."
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers."
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements."
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits."
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates."
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation."
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts."
            ledgerDatabase = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement."
            customerDatabase = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records."
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail."
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data."
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs."
        }

        mobileApp = softwareSystem "Mobile App" "The bank's mobile app."
        cardPaymentNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "A card payment network operated by a different organization."
        creditReferenceAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "A credit reference agency operated by a different organization."

        bankCustomer -> bankPortal "uses"
        bankCustomer -> mobileApp "uses"
        mobileApp -> mobileAppBackend "uses"

        webPortal -> accountService "uses"
        webPortal -> transactionService "uses"
        webPortal -> paymentService "uses"
        webPortal -> cardService "uses"
        webPortal -> statementsService "uses"
        webPortal -> directDebitService "uses"

        mobileAppBackend -> accountService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> transactionService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> paymentService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> cardService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> statementsService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> directDebitService "uses"

        transactionService -> ledgerDatabase "updates"
        transactionService -> fraudDetectionService "scores transactions with"
        transactionService -> eventQueue "publishes events to"

        notificationService -> eventQueue "consumes events from"

        statementsService -> ledgerDatabase "reads"
        statementsService -> documentStore "writes to"

        batchScheduler -> ledgerDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> customerDatabase "reads and writes"

        paymentService -> cardService "uses"
        paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "uses"
        paymentService -> cardPaymentNetwork "routes card authorisations through"

        onboardingService -> customerDatabase "reads"
        onboardingService -> creditReferenceAgency "performs credit checks through"
    }

    views {
        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "The system context diagram for the Bank Portal." {
            include *
            autolayout
        }
        container bankPortal "Containers" "The container diagram for the Bank Portal, showing its application parts." {
            include *
            autolayout
        }
    }
}

workspace "Bank Portal" "A C4 model of the online banking platform." {

    model {

        bankCustomer = person "Bank Customer" "A customer of the bank who uses the platform to manage their accounts, move money, and track their activity."

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform, owned and operated by our company." {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts."
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app."
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records."
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers."
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers."
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards."
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud."
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts."

workspace "Bank Portal" "A C4 model of the online banking platform." {

    model {

        bankCustomer = person "Bank Customer" "A customer of the bank who uses the platform to manage their accounts, move money, and track their activity."

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform, owned and operated by our company." {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts."
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app."
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records."
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers."
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers."
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards."
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud."
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts."
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers."
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements."
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits."
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates."
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation."
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts."
            ledgerDatabase = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement."
            customerDatabase = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records."
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail."
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data."
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs."
        }

        mobileApp = softwareSystem "Mobile App" "The bank's mobile app."
        cardPaymentNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "A card payment network operated by a different organization."
        creditReferenceAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "A credit reference agency operated by a different organization."

        bankCustomer -> webPortal "uses"
        bankCustomer -> mobileApp "uses"
        mobileApp -> mobileAppBackend "uses"

        webPortal -> accountService "uses"
        webPortal -> transactionService "uses"
        webPortal -> paymentService "uses"
        webPortal -> cardService "uses"
        webPortal -> statementsService "uses"
        webPortal -> directDebitService "uses"

        mobileAppBackend -> accountService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> transactionService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> paymentService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> cardService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> statementsService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> directDebitService "uses"

        transactionService -> ledgerDatabase "updates"
        transactionService -> fraudDetectionService "scores transactions with"
        transactionService -> eventQueue "publishes events to"

        notificationService -> eventQueue "consumes events from"

        statementsService -> ledgerDatabase "reads"
        statementsService -> documentStore "writes to"

        batchScheduler -> ledgerDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> customerDatabase "reads and writes"

        paymentService -> cardService "uses"
        paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "uses"
        paymentService -> cardPaymentNetwork "routes card authorisations through"

        onboardingService -> customerDatabase "reads"
        onboardingService -> creditReferenceAgency "performs credit checks through"
    }

    views {
        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "System context diagram for the Bank Portal." {
            include *
            autolayout
        }
        container bankPortal "Containers" "Container diagram for the Bank Portal, showing its application parts." {
            include *
            autolayout
        }
    }
}

workspace "Bank Portal" "A C4 model of the online banking platform" {

            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers."
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards."
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud."
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts."
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers."
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements."
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits."
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates."
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation."
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts."
            ledgerDatabase = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement."
            customerDatabase = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records."
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail."
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data."
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs."
        }

        mobileApp = softwareSystem "Mobile App" "The bank's mobile app."
        cardPaymentNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "A card payment network operated by a different organization."
        creditReferenceAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "A credit reference agency operated by a different organization."

        bankCustomer -> webPortal "uses to manage accounts, move money, and track activity"
        bankCustomer -> mobileApp "uses"
        mobileApp -> mobileAppBackend "uses"

        webPortal -> accountService "uses"
        webPortal -> transactionService "uses"
        webPortal -> paymentService "uses"
        webPortal -> cardService "uses"
        webPortal -> statementsService "uses"
        webPortal -> directDebitService "uses"

        mobileAppBackend -> accountService "uses"

        mobileAppBackend -> paymentService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> cardService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> statementsService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> directDebitService "uses"

        transactionService -> ledgerDatabase "updates"
        transactionService -> fraudDetectionService "scores transactions with"
        transactionService -> eventQueue "publishes events to"

        notificationService -> eventQueue "consumes events from"

        statementsService -> ledgerDatabase "reads"
        statementsService -> documentStore "writes to"

        batchScheduler -> ledgerDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> customerDatabase "reads and writes"

        paymentService -> cardService "uses"
        paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "uses"
        paymentService -> cardPaymentNetwork "routes card authorisations through"

        onboardingService -> customerDatabase "reads"
        onboardingService -> creditReferenceAgency "performs credit checks through"

        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "The system context diagram for the Bank Portal." {
            include *
            autolayout

            include *
            autolayout
        }
    }
}

workspace "Claims Center" "C4 model of the insurance company's claims platform" {

    model {

        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "Owned and operated by the insurance company; policyholders use it to report claims and track their progress" {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Web Application" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Service" "Serves the insurer's mobile app"
            intakeService = container "Claims Intake Service" "Service" "Registers new claims"
            triageService = container "Triage Service" "Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims"
            assessmentService = container "Assessment Service" "Service" "Calculates settlement amounts"
            payoutService = container "Payout Service" "Service" "Executes claim settlements"
            fraudScreeningService = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Service" "Flags suspicious claims"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Service" "Emails and messages policyholders"
            assignmentService = container "Assignment Service" "Service" "Routes claims to adjusters"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Web Application" "Where staff process their assigned claims"
            policyVerificationService = container "Policy Verification Service" "Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy"
            reinsuranceAllocationService = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Service" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims Database" "Database" "Stores claim records"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy Database" "Database" "Stores policy and cover records"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence"
        }

        dataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks progress"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks progress via the mobile app"

        webPortal -> intakeService "reaches"
        webPortal -> assessmentService "reaches"
        webPortal -> payoutService "reaches"
        webPortal -> documentService "reaches"
        webPortal -> notificationService "reaches"

        mobileAppBackend -> intakeService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessmentService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> payoutService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> notificationService "reaches"

        intakeService -> triageService "hands accepted claims"
        triageService -> assessmentService "routes claims"
        assessmentService -> payoutService "requests settlements"

        assignmentService -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes"
        notificationService -> policyholder "reports claim status changes"

        fraudScreeningService -> dataBureau "consults"
        payoutService -> clearingHouse "executes settlements"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "System context diagram of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
        container claimsCenter "Containers" "Container diagram of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}

metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Insurance Claims Platform" "C4 model of the Claims Center, the insurance company's claims platform" {

    !identifiers hierarchical

    model {

        properties {
            "structurizr.inspection.element.disconnected.severity" "ignore"
            "structurizr.inspection.element.disconnected" "ignore"
            "structurizr.inspection.softwareSystem.documentation.severity" "ignore"
            "structurizr.inspection.softwareSystem.documentation" "ignore"
            "structurizr.inspection.softwareSystem.decisions.severity" "ignore"
            "structurizr.inspection.softwareSystem.decisions" "ignore"
        }

        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "A customer of the insurance company who reports claims and tracks their progress"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform for reporting, processing, and settling claims" {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress" "Web Application" "Web"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app" "REST API" "API"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims" "Microservice" "Service"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims" "Microservice" "Service"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts" "Microservice" "Service"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements" "Microservice" "Service"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims" "Microservice" "Service"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports" "Microservice" "Service"
            notification = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders" "Microservice" "Service"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters" "Microservice" "Service"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims" "Web Application" "Web"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy" "Microservice" "Service"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners" "Microservice" "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation" "Batch Job" "Batch"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts" "Message Queue" "Queue"
            claimsDb = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records" "Relational Database" "Database"
            policyDb = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records" "Relational Database" "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail" "Relational Database" "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence" "Object Storage" "Storage"
        }

        claimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization" "External"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization" "External"

        # Policyholders use the platform to report claims and track their progress
        policyholder -> claimsCenter.webPortal "reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS"
        policyholder -> claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS"

        # The web portal and the mobile app backend reach the intake, assessment, payout, document, and notification services
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.claimsIntake "submits new claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.assessment "requests settlement amounts from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.payout "requests settlements from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.documentService "uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.notification "requests status notifications from" "HTTPS"

        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.claimsIntake "submits new claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.assessment "requests settlement amounts from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.payout "requests settlements from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.documentService "uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.notification "requests status notifications from" "HTTPS"

        # The claims intake service hands accepted claims to the triage service, the triage service routes them to the assessment service, and the assessment service requests settlements from the payout service
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.triage "hands accepted claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.triage -> claimsCenter.assessment "routes claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.assessment -> claimsCenter.payout "requests settlements from" "HTTPS"

        # The fraud screening service screens each incoming claim, the policy verification service checks the cover, and the assignment service routes the claim to the adjuster workbench
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.fraudScreening "sends incoming claims for screening" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.policyVerification "sends claims for cover verification" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.assignment "sends claims for assignment" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.assignment -> claimsCenter.adjusterWorkbench "routes claims to" "HTTPS"

        # The document service reads from the document store, the batch scheduler reads and writes the claims and policy databases, and the notification service reports claim status changes
        claimsCenter.documentService -> claimsCenter.documentStore "reads from" "TCP"
        claimsCenter.batchScheduler -> claimsCenter.claimsDb "reads and writes" "SQL"
        claimsCenter.batchScheduler -> claimsCenter.policyDb "reads and writes" "SQL"
        claimsCenter.notification -> policyholder "reports claim status changes by email and message" "SMTP, SMS"

        # The fraud screening service consults a national claims data bureau operated by a different organization
        claimsCenter.fraudScreening -> claimsDataBureau "consults claims data" "HTTPS"

        # The payout service executes settlements through a clearing house operated by a different organization
        claimsCenter.payout -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through" "HTTPS"
    }

    views {

        systemContext claimsCenter "ClaimsCenterContext" "System context for the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "Claims Center - System Context"
        }

        container claimsCenter "ClaimsCenterContainers" "Containers of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "Claims Center - Containers"
        }

        styles {
            element "Person" {
                shape Person
                background #08427B
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Software System" {
                background #1168BD
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "External" {
                background #999999
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Web" {
                shape WebBrowser
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "API" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Service" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Batch" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Queue" {
                shape Pipe
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Database" {
                shape Cylinder
                background #336791
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Storage" {
                background #336791
                color #ffffff
            }
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope softwaresystem
    }
}

workspace "Claims Center" "Insurance claims platform" {

    !identifiers hierarchical

    model {
        properties {
            "structurizr.inspection.missingDocumentation" "ignore"
            "structurizr.inspection.missingDecisions" "ignore"
            "structurizr.inspection.disconnectedElement" "ignore"
        }

        # People
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"
        adjuster = person "Adjuster" "Processes assigned claims"

        # External systems
        claimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization" "External"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization" "External"

        # Main system
        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "Insurance claims platform owned and operated by the insurance company" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress" "HTML/JavaScript" "Web"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app" "Java"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims" "Java"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims" "Java"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts" "Java"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements" "Java"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims" "Java"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports" "Java"
            notification = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders" "Java"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters" "Java"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims" "HTML/JavaScript"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy" "Java"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners" "Java"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation" "Java"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts" "RabbitMQ" "Queue"
            claimsDb = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records" "PostgreSQL" "Database"
            policyDb = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records" "PostgreSQL" "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail" "PostgreSQL" "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence" "S3" "Database"
        }

        # Relationships
        policyholder -> claimsCenter.webPortal "reports claims and tracks progress" "HTTPS"
        policyholder -> claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks progress" "HTTPS"
        adjuster -> claimsCenter.adjusterWorkbench "processes assigned claims" "HTTPS"

        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.claimsIntake "submits new claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.assessment "requests settlement amounts from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.payout "requests settlements from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.documentService "uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.notification "requests status notifications from" "HTTPS"

        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.claimsIntake "submits new claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.assessment "requests settlement amounts from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.payout "requests settlements from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.documentService "uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.notification "requests status notifications from" "HTTPS"

        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.triage "hands accepted claims to" "gRPC"
        claimsCenter.triage -> claimsCenter.assessment "routes claims to" "gRPC"
        claimsCenter.assessment -> claimsCenter.payout "requests settlements from" "gRPC"

        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.fraudScreening "sends incoming claims for screening" "gRPC"
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.policyVerification "sends claims for cover verification" "gRPC"
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.assignment "sends claims for assignment" "gRPC"
        claimsCenter.assignment -> claimsCenter.adjusterWorkbench "routes claims to" "gRPC"

        claimsCenter.documentService -> claimsCenter.documentStore "reads from" "S3 API"
        claimsCenter.batchScheduler -> claimsCenter.claimsDb "reads and writes" "SQL"
        claimsCenter.batchScheduler -> claimsCenter.policyDb "reads and writes" "SQL"
        claimsCenter.notification -> policyholder "sends claim status updates by email and message" "Email/SMS"

        claimsCenter.fraudScreening -> claimsDataBureau "consults claims data" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.payout -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through" "HTTPS"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "System Context for Claims Center"
        }

        container claimsCenter "Containers" {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "Containers for Claims Center"
        }

        styles {
            element "Person" {
                shape Person
                background #08427B
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Software System" {
                background #1168BD
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "External" {
                background #999999
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Container" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Database" {
                shape Cylinder
            }
            element "Queue" {
                shape Pipe
            }
            element "Web" {
                shape WebBrowser
            }
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope softwaresystem
    }
}
